audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint findings (MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE) left in place by the propose pass.
audit.why: QA lint pass: pronouns corrected to the enemy champion's gender, duplicated trade lines replaced with field-specific bodies, cooldown fields given real per-rank numbers from champ-data/_kits, magnitude claim backed with a number.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: Time the pulse on his dash arrival and the engage becomes your trade — fear him at your feet, Q the mark, and auto before he answers.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: With the pulse already spent, every step past the river runs on his clock — he re-engages before your fear is back and the chase ends on you.

notes: QA lint pass: mechanical fixes only.
